stemMd: Which integer is the greatest common divisor of 84 and 126?
explanationMd: Factor 84 = 2² × 3 × 7 and 126 = 2 × 3² × 7. Take the minimum exponent of each common prime, giving 2 × 3 × 7 = 42. Both numbers are integer multiples of 42.

distractorRationale.c: Twenty-one divides both but is not the greatest common divisor.
distractorRationale.b: Fourteen divides both but is not the greatest.
distractorRationale.e: This is the least common multiple, not a divisor.
distractorRationale.a: Six is a common divisor but smaller than another available one.
